#+TITLE: TZif verification fixtures

Compiled IANA tzdata =2026e=, copied from this host's zoneinfo installation.
Files are exact, unmodified TZif bytes, used to check the pure reader against
known transition boundaries and Python's independent zoneinfo implementation.
The tz database data is public domain: https://www.iana.org/time-zones.
This test data is not an automatic promise of future coverage. The reader
explicitly exposes unsupported recurring footers and unspecified intervals.

Format reference: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9636.html.

=python3 test/fixtures/time-zones/generate_reference.py= regenerates 1,315
offset checks. The points include supported transition boundaries ±1 second and
monthly samples. New York's unsupported future footer boundary is tested as
unknown separately, rather than disguised as an offset-agreement assertion.
